name: deepline-gtm
cost: Paid Deepline credits. The free tier includes 100 credits
works_with: Claude Code (primary), Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Antigravity. Needs the Deepline CLI
short: Routes your coding agent through lead sourcing, enrichment and outbound tasks using the Deepline CLI and 40+ data providers.
what: The main skill in a set of sales prospecting skills. It tells your coding agent how to build lead lists, find emails, phones and LinkedIn URLs, score accounts and write outreach, using the Deepline CLI to call providers like Apollo, Crustdata, PDL and Hunter with fallbacks between them. It includes rules for piloting on a small sample and asking for approval before paid runs.
who: GTM engineers, founders and sales ops people who work from CSVs and want an agent to run enrichment for them. Skip it if you don't want a paid Deepline account or don't do outbound prospecting.
needs: Node.js with npm, to install the Deepline CLI
A coding agent that supports SKILL.md files

steps.title: Install the skills
steps.text: Installs all skills in the repo. Add --global to make them available in every project.

steps.title: Or install only this skill and a few related ones
steps.code: npx skills add getaero-io/gtm-eng-skills --skill deepline-gtm build-tam linkedin-url-lookup

steps.title: Install the Deepline CLI and log in
steps.text: From the README's prerequisites. The skill's own quick start uses npm install -g deepline and deepline auth register --wait auto instead.

steps.title: Or use the one-line installer
steps.text: This pipes a remote script into your shell.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Enrich the leads in this CSV, score them against my ICP, and queue the top 50 in Lemlist

watch: Enrichment uses paid Deepline credits. The skill says planning is not approval for paid work and asks before full runs, but check spend with deepline billing balance.

The curl installer pipes a script into bash. Read the script first. The README's other quick start asks your agent to follow instructions from https://code.deepline.com/agent-install.txt, so read that file before pasting the prompt.
Your lead data and the people you look up are sent to Deepline and third-party data providers. The skills find personal emails, phone numbers and LinkedIn profiles.
Unless you say otherwise, the skill tells the agent to send bug reports with deepline feedback send when things fail. It asks before uploading the whole session.
The README and the skill name different npm packages for the CLI (@deepline/cli and deepline).
